FieldReady Academy

CIIP Study Guide and Practice Tests

CIIP Academy is a free study guide and practice-test course for the ABII Certified Imaging Informatics Professional exam. Sixty-five lessons follow the exam's ten domains from the seat of the person who runs PACS and imaging IT, a printable CIIP cheat sheet collects the DICOM, HL7, storage, network, and capacity facts worth memorizing, and every practice test is built from the exam's domain weights. Use it as your CIIP study guide, take a CIIP practice test as often as you like on a bank of original CIIP exam questions, and prepare for the imaging informatics certification and the PACS administrator certification path, free while the site launches.

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 170 questions in 170 minutes, at its real passing score of 75%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the CIIP exam?

170 questions in 2 hours 50 minutes. 130 are scored and 40 are unscored pilot questions you cannot tell apart. Another 20 minutes cover the tutorial, the non-disclosure agreement, and a survey. Most questions are single best answer; some ask for several answers, show an exhibit or video, or ask you to click a hot area. You must answer each question before the next appears, and you can flag questions to review.

How is the CIIP scored?

ABII reports a scaled score from 1 to 99, and 75 passes. The scaled score is not the percentage of questions you got right. This course's official-format test asks for 75 percent.

When and where can I take the CIIP?

Any day, at a Pearson VUE test center or online with a remote proctor. There are no testing windows. You get three attempts within 12 months of being found eligible.

Who is eligible for the CIIP?

ABII uses a seven-point system. You need at least 7 points: 1 to 5 for experience (one point per 12 months as a credentialed imaging professional, a healthcare IT or informatics professional, or a military radiologic technologist), 0 to 5 for your highest degree plus 1 for an imaging informatics degree, and 1 to 4 for imaging informatics continuing education (one point per 10 hours earned in the 18 months before you apply). Radiologic and biomed technologists moving into imaging IT often start with our CRES Academy course.

How much does the CIIP cost?

The exam is $500 and a retake is $250. Certification is kept with 24 continuing education credits every two years and an annual renewal.

How many practice tests should I take?

This course asks for three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one full-length 170-question test in the real exam's format at 75%.

Is the course free?

Yes. The lessons, the cheat sheet, and unlimited practice tests are free while the site launches.

What is on the Certified Imaging Informatics Professional CIIP exam?

Procurement (4%), Project Management (5%), Operations (12%), Communications (5%), Training and Education (4%), Image Management (18%), Information Technology (12%), Systems Management (16%), Clinical Engineering (10%), Medical Imaging Informatics (14%). The course's units follow the same domains, and the practice tests draw on the same domain weights.
